howToConsume: Start at INDEX.md (human) or here (machine). Each page: pages/<slug>/ with page.md (digest), screenshot.png, page.html (editable baseline), content.md (verbatim copy), computed-tokens.json, meta.json. description.method=ai means model-written orientation prose, not extracted fact.

home.label: Landing
home.title: Razorpay - Best Payment Solution for Online Payments India

description.text: Razorpay's marketing homepage and the root of the whole public site: a rotating hero promoting one product at a time, then a full directory of the payments, banking, payroll and credit lines, ending in a FAQ and a sign-up call.

engage.label: Engage
engage.title: Razorpay Engage: Payments powered growth marketing suite

description.text: Razorpay Engage: a growth-marketing suite built on payments data, selling offers, gift cards and loyalty as one platform. Its call to action is "Talk to an expert", marking it as a sales-led enterprise product.
Razorpay Startup Perks: a benefits programme offering up to ₹1 crore in credits and discounts to funded startups, gated by funding stage rather than sold as a product.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Payment Gateway Charges - Simple & Transparent Pricing

description.text: The public pricing page, organised as four tabs (Payments, Business Banking, Payroll, Credit Solutions) with a per-method rate card and an enterprise contact route for anyone above five lakh monthly revenue.

x-payouts-90f368.label: X Details
x-payouts-90f368.title: Payouts: Send Instant Bulk Payments for Businesses at RazorpayX

description.text: RazorpayX Payouts: the outbound-money engine of the banking suite, covering bank accounts, UPI, cards and wallets, with bulk files up to 50,000 payouts.

support-payments.label: Support Details
support-payments.title: Contact Razorpay Customer Care – Razorpay Support

description.text: The support entry point, built as a persona router: five role cards that ask who you are before offering any help content, on an older template than the rest of the site.

accept-international-payments.displayLabel: Accept International Payments for Global Business | Razorpay
accept-international-payments.title: Accept International Payments for Global Business | Razorpay

description.text: The international payments page, positioned against competitors rather than around a feature set: its argument is that Indian exporters should not have to route through foreign middlemen.

ai-builders.displayLabel: AI Builder Jobs at Razorpay | Hiring AI Talent
ai-builders.title: AI Builder Jobs at Razorpay | Hiring AI Talent

description.text: A standalone dark-themed recruiting page for Razorpay's AI Builders hiring drive, deliberately styled apart from the rest of the site and pointing at an external Typeform rather than a normal job application.

card-tokenisation.displayLabel: Secure 'Card Tokenisation' solution for seamless payments experience | Fully compliant with RBI guidelines
card-tokenisation.title: Secure 'Card Tokenisation' solution for seamless payments experience | Fully compliant with RBI guidelines

description.text: Razorpay TokenHQ, the card-tokenisation product, sold on RBI compliance. Visually it is the outlier of the library: an older template in a teal and dark-blue palette that shares almost nothing with the current site.

demo.displayLabel: Best Payment Gateway in India to Accept Online Payments
demo.title: Best Payment Gateway in India to Accept Online Payments

description.text: A live demo storefront that sells a "Fine Tshirt" for ₹1 to show Razorpay Checkout working end to end. The transaction is real and auto-refunded. Its capture in this library is broken and should not be used as visual evidence.
The API Reference Guide from Razorpay's developer documentation, and the only page in this library that is not part of the marketing site. It is a different product with a different design system.

invoices.displayLabel: Free Online Invoicing & Billing Software - Create GST Invoices Online
invoices.title: Free Online Invoicing & Billing Software - Create GST Invoices Online

description.text: The Invoices product page: GST-compliant invoices that are payable in one click, sold to businesses that need to bill and chase receivables rather than run a checkout.

magic.displayLabel: Razorpay Magic Checkout to Boost Conversions and Reduce RTOs
magic.title: Razorpay Magic Checkout to Boost Conversions and Reduce RTOs

description.text: Razorpay Magic Checkout: a one-tap checkout that pre-fills the buyer's details and uses prediction to decide who is allowed cash on delivery. Aimed squarely at D2C brands losing money to returns.

optimizer-intelligent-payments-routing.displayLabel: Optimizer - simplified payments management for enterprises
optimizer-intelligent-payments-routing.title: Optimizer - simplified payments management for enterprises

description.text: Razorpay Optimizer: a routing switch that spreads transactions across multiple payment gateways, sold to enterprises already using more than one provider.

partners.displayLabel: Razorpay Partner Program - Payment Gateway Affiliate Program India
partners.title: Razorpay Partner Program - Payment Gateway Affiliate Program India

description.text: The Razorpay Partner Program page: a recurring-commission channel programme for agencies, SaaS platforms and consultants who bring clients to Razorpay.

payment-buttons.displayLabel: Collect Payments Online on Websites, Blogs with Payment Buttons
payment-buttons.title: Collect Payments Online on Websites, Blogs with Payment Buttons

description.text: The Payment Buttons product page: a copy-paste snippet that puts a Pay Now button on any site, and the clearest example in this library of a page on an older template than the rest of the site.

payment-gateway.displayLabel: Online Payment Gateway in India for Businesses | Razorpay
payment-gateway.title: Online Payment Gateway in India for Businesses | Razorpay

description.text: The flagship product page for Razorpay's core payment gateway, leading with a zero-platform-fee offer and a sign-up form in the hero, then arguing the product through reliability, integrations and a long FAQ.

payment-links-2.displayLabel: Razorpay Payment Links: Create Simple Payment Links & Get Paid Instantly
payment-links-2.title: Razorpay Payment Links: Create Simple Payment Links & Get Paid Instantly

description.text: The Payment Links product page: a no-code way to request money by sending a link, pitched across six industries and cross-sold against the rest of the no-code stack.

payment-pages.displayLabel: Create Hosted Custom Payment Pages & Accept Payments Instantly
payment-pages.title: Create Hosted Custom Payment Pages & Accept Payments Instantly

description.text: The Payment Pages product page: a hosted, no-code storefront a business can launch without a website, sold on speed of setup and pitched at five industries including non-profits and events.

payments-app.displayLabel: Razorpay Mobile App - Track & accept payments on the go
payments-app.title: Razorpay Mobile App - Track & accept payments on the go

description.text: The Razorpay mobile app page: a companion app for tracking and accepting payments on a phone, and one of the thinner marketing pages in the library.

payroll.displayLabel: Payroll Software: Razorpay Payroll Software in India | HR Payroll - Razorpay Payroll
payroll.title: Payroll Software: Razorpay Payroll Software in India | HR Payroll - Razorpay Payroll

description.text: RazorpayX Payroll: automated salary processing and statutory compliance, sold on getting a company live in an hour and on never filing tax returns by hand again.

pos.displayLabel: Razorpay POS Machine : Smart Swipe Machine for In-Store Payments
pos.title: Razorpay POS Machine : Smart Swipe Machine for In-Store Payments

description.text: The Razorpay POS page: physical in-store hardware, and the only page in this library selling a device rather than software. Its call to action is Contact Sales, not Sign Up.

qr-code.displayLabel: UPI QR Code Generator for Payments | Razorpay QR Solutions
qr-code.title: UPI QR Code Generator for Payments | Razorpay QR Solutions

description.text: The QR code product page, and the only page in this library that ships a working tool: a free UPI QR generator that produces a downloadable code in the page, used as the lead magnet for the paid product behind it.

smart-collect.displayLabel: Smart Collect 2.0 - Automated Reconciliation of Collections via Bank Transfer
smart-collect.title: Smart Collect 2.0 - Automated Reconciliation of Collections via Bank Transfer

description.text: Smart Collect 2.0: automated reconciliation of incoming bank transfers, branded as a RazorpayX product despite living on the razorpay.com payments path.

solutions-e-commerce.displayLabel: Ecommerce Payment gateway - Empower your Online Store with Razorpay
solutions-e-commerce.title: Ecommerce Payment gateway - Empower your Online Store with Razorpay

description.text: An industry landing page for online stores, leaning on affordability payments, COD fraud prevention and working capital more than on checkout mechanics.

solutions-saas.displayLabel: Razorpay for SaaS - Payment gateway for your Saas Product
solutions-saas.title: Razorpay for SaaS - Payment gateway for your Saas Product

description.text: An industry landing page for SaaS and IT businesses, assembling the existing payments products into a vertical pitch rather than introducing anything new.

subscriptions.displayLabel: Best Subscription & Recurring Billing Platform in India - Free Demo
subscriptions.title: Best Subscription & Recurring Billing Platform in India - Free Demo

description.text: The Subscriptions product page: recurring billing across cards, UPI AutoPay and eMandate, with UPI AutoPay pushed hardest as the way to reach customers who have no card.

upi-autopay.displayLabel: Razorpay UPI Autopay for Recurring UPI Payments
upi-autopay.title: Razorpay UPI Autopay for Recurring UPI Payments

description.text: Razorpay UPI Autopay: recurring payments over UPI mandates, sold on collection rates and retry mechanics rather than on setup convenience. The most metric-dense product page in the library.

x.displayLabel: RazorpayX - The All-In-One Business Banking Suite
x.title: RazorpayX - The All-In-One Business Banking Suite

description.text: The RazorpayX landing page: the business-banking half of the company, presenting payouts, escrow, vendor payments, payroll and corporate cards as one suite for a finance team rather than a checkout.

x-corporate-cards.displayLabel: Corporate Credit Card | Turn Business Spends to Savings with RazorpayX Corporate Card
x-corporate-cards.title: Corporate Credit Card | Turn Business Spends to Savings with RazorpayX Corporate Card

description.text: RazorpayX Corporate Card: a credit card for startups pitched at turning SaaS, marketing and cloud spend into savings, with no joining or annual fee.

x-current-accounts.displayLabel: Open Current Account Online for Businesses | Business Banking Account
x-current-accounts.title: Open Current Account Online for Businesses | Business Banking Account

description.text: RazorpayX Current Account: a business bank account positioned as a finance command centre rather than a place to keep money, and the only page in the library that offers a live product demo.

x-escrow-accounts.displayLabel: Escrow Account in India | Escrow Services | Razorpay Escrow
x-escrow-accounts.title: Escrow Account in India | Escrow Services | Razorpay Escrow

description.text: RazorpayX Escrow: managed escrow accounts for businesses holding money on behalf of third parties, sold on compliance and named banking partners.

x-forex.displayLabel: Forex for Startups - Forex Funding - RazorpayX
x-forex.title: Forex for Startups - Forex Funding - RazorpayX

description.text: RazorpayX Forex: inbound foreign funding for Indian startups, and the most problem-led page in the library. It opens by asserting the existing system is broken rather than by naming a feature.

x-payout-links.displayLabel: Payout Links by RazorpayX | Instant, Easy & Secure Payments
x-payout-links.title: Payout Links by RazorpayX | Instant, Easy & Secure Payments

description.text: RazorpayX Payout Links: send money to someone whose bank details you do not have, by sending them a link they redeem. The page carries a live demo form that creates a real payout link.

x-tax-payments.displayLabel: Tax Payment - Online Tax Payment for Businesses | RazorpayX
x-tax-payments.title: Tax Payment - Online Tax Payment for Businesses | RazorpayX

description.text: RazorpayX Tax Payments: paying business taxes from the RazorpayX account. In practice the page is mostly the generic RazorpayX account pitch, with the tax-specific content confined to a couple of sections.

x-vendor-payments.displayLabel: Vendor Payments | Add, Track & Clear Vendor Invoices & TDS Payments - RazorpayX
x-vendor-payments.title: Vendor Payments | Add, Track & Clear Vendor Invoices & TDS Payments - RazorpayX

description.text: RazorpayX Vendor Payments: accounts-payable software covering invoice capture, approvals, payment and TDS, sold as the path from bill to closed books.
